lines: You take a split log off the pile. Dry, and lighter than it looks.
otherwise: You've already got one under your arm. One at a time is how the fire likes it.
fixtures.heldBlurb: A split log off the Belvedere's pile, tucked under your arm for the fire.

lines: You set the log on the fire and it catches.
Everybody round the ring leans back an inch, and somebody says thanks without looking up.
otherwise: The fire's going fine; it could use a log from the pile.
